name: Currency-code stat card swap
looks: Under a small section label and hairline rule, a two-line claim stacks in (first line bold, second dimmer), then a big three-letter currency code and a count-with-caption sit below a divider. The currency code and its count swap once to a second country, the new pair landing brighter than the first.
build: List-stack-reveal for the two-line claim. The code and the stat beneath are two DOM text nodes that crossfade/translateY on the same beat (power2.out, ~0.3s), so the pair reads as one synced swap rather than two separate cuts.
sound: A tick on each stacked line, then a single swap hit when the card changes.
prompt: State a broad capability as a two-line claim that stacks in, then show one concrete instance of it as a big code or label with a small stat beneath a divider. Swap that instance once to a second, bigger example, landing brighter, to prove the claim covers more than one case.
